referenceSources.title: La Peugeot 405 MI16, rien à voir avec une GTI
referenceSources.description:
The Peugeot 405 MI16, introduced in 1987, combined Pininfarina styling with a 1.9‑liter, 16‑valve engine delivering 160 hp. Capable of 220 km/h and 0–100 km/h in 9 seconds, it offered a refined alternative to hot hatches. The sedan’s understated rear spoiler, black side moldings, and 14‑inch alloy wheels underscored its blend of elegance and sportiness.

Over its production run, the MI16 evolved with a 4x4 variant, a facelift in 1992, and a final Le Mans special edition in 1994. Despite strong competition from German rivals and Citroën’s turbocharged models, the 405 MI16 remains a celebrated example of French automotive engineering from the late 1980s and early 1990s.
